title: Global Voices, Local Biases: Socio-Cultural Prejudices across Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Modified Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) measuring cosine similarities between contextualized embeddings of male/female names and terms related to career/family, math/art, and science/art, as well as testing toxicity associations (offensive/respectful words with female/male terms).
Modified WEAT evaluating associations between disability-related words or mental/physical diseases and attributes like temporary/permanent, female/male terms, and unpleasant/pleasant words.
Modified WEAT measuring the relative proximity in latent space between LGBTQ+/Straight words and attribute words representing prejudice/pride and unpleasant/pleasant concepts.
Modified WEAT assessing associations between educated/non-educated terms and higher-status/lower-status words across different cultural contexts.
Modified WEAT examining the differential association of immigrant/non-immigrant terms with disrespectful/respectful words.
Modified WEAT evaluating associations between adjectives and religion-specific terms or last names in Indian languages.
Modified WEAT testing associations between adjectives and specific caste names in Indian languages.
Modified WEAT assessing associations between descriptive adjectives and urban/rural occupations in the Indian context.
